@startuml
actor Customer
participant "CheckoutService" as CS
participant "PaymentGateway" as PG
participant "Database" as DB
participant "Shop" as Shop

Customer -> CS : initiate checkout()
CS -> PG : verifyPaymentDetails()
alt payment details valid
    PG --> CS : verificationSuccess
    CS -> DB : saveOrder()
    DB --> CS : orderSaved
    CS -> PG : processPayment()
    PG --> CS : paymentSuccess
    CS -> Shop : displayResult(success)
    Shop --> Customer : show confirmation
else payment details invalid
    PG --> CS : verificationFailed
    CS -> Shop : displayResult(error)
    Shop --> Customer : show error message
end
@enduml

sequenceDiagram
  actor Client
  participant Gateway as API Gateway
  participant Cache as Token Cache
  participant Auth as Authentication Service
  participant Order as Order Service

  Client->>Gateway: POST /order (JWT)
  Gateway->>Cache: Check token validation
  Cache-->>Gateway: (cache hit) valid
  alt token in cache (valid)
    Gateway->>Order: forward request
    Order-->>Gateway: order list
    Gateway-->>Client: order list
  else token not in cache
    Gateway->>Auth: verify token
    Auth-->>Gateway: token valid/invalid
    Gateway->>Cache: store result
    alt token valid
      Gateway->>Order: forward request
      Order-->>Gateway: order list
      Gateway-->>Client: order list
    else token invalid
      Gateway-->>Client: 401 Unauthorized
    end
  end

@startuml
actor Client
participant "API Gateway" as GW
participant "Token Cache" as Cache
participant "Authentication Service" as Auth
participant "Order Service" as Order

Client -> GW : POST /order (JWT)
GW -> Cache : lookup token
Cache --> GW : not found
GW -> Auth : verify token
Auth --> GW : token valid
GW -> Cache : store validation result
alt token valid
    GW -> Order : forward request
    Order --> GW : order list
    GW --> Client : order list
else token invalid
    GW --> Client : 401 Unauthorized
end
@enduml

      ControlUnit-->>Assistant: brake pressure adjusted
    end
    Assistant->>DiagnosticLog: record event

    Assistant->>Driver: distance warning
    Assistant->>DiagnosticLog: log risk
  end
